'''''Farfugium''''' is a [[genus]] of [[flowering plant]]s in the [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] Asteraceae,<ref>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/32026175#page/11/mode/1up Lindley, John. 1857. Gardeners' Chronicle & Agricultural Gazette 1857: 4] description in Latin, commentary in English.</ref><ref>[http://www.tropicos.org/Name/40008593 Tropicos, ''Farfugium'' Lindl.]</ref><ref name="fna">{{cite journal| url = http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=20544| accessdate = 2009-08-07
 | author = Flora of North America| authorlink = Flora of North America| volume = 20| journal = Family List| pages = 540| title = Senecioneae}}</ref><ref name="EUROMED">{{cite web| url = http://ww2.bgbm.org/EuroPlusMed/PTaxonDetail.asp?NameId=131779&PTRefFk=7000000| title = Details for: ''Senecioneae''| accessdate = 2009-08-07| author = Botanic Garden and Botanical Museum Berlin-Dahlem| authorlink = Botanical Garden in Berlin| work = Euro+Med PlantBase | publisher = [[Free University of Berlin|Freie Universität Berlin]]}}</ref> [[native plant|native]] to streams and seashores in east Asia.  They are [[rhizomatous]] [[evergreen]] [[perennial plant|perennials]] with rounded leathery leaves and bright yellow flowers in autumn and winter. Species include ''[[Farfugium japonicum]]'', with [[variegation|variegated]] cultivars for use in horticulture.<ref>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=112648 Flora of China Vol. 20-21 Page 375 <big>大吴风草属</big> da wu feng cao shu ''Farfugium'' Lindley, Gard. Chron. 4. 1857. ]</ref>

; Species
* ''[[Farfugium hiberniflorum]]'' <small>(Makino) Kitam.</small> - [[Kyushu]]
* ''[[Farfugium japonicum]]'' <small>(L.) Kitam.</small> - [[China]], [[Korea]], [[Japan]] (incl [[Nansei-shoto]] + [[Ogasawara-shoto]])
